build: release, extension-module, matched Cargo.lock and data; macOS dynamic_lookup
configuration:
# Pure-AFD single-point prediction (phase=both, no P/D companion).
#
# Maps to the runner's internal deployment_mode="afd": the AFD pool runs on the
# SGLang continuous-batching scheduler core (mid-flight admission + retract
# preemption, the whole pool bounded by max_num_seqs = n_a_workers *
# a_batch_size) with the `"aic-afd"` timing provider injected (measured at
# replay time, no compile-time frozen measurement). Scheduling and perf data
# are anchored to the sglang family together.
#
# Conventions:
#   - a pure-AFD phase must be both (combined_with_pd: false)
#   - the native path also accepts trace / variable-length synthetic traffic
#     (this golden case uses a fixed-length synthetic source)
#   - a_batch_size must be a concrete memory-qualified value (no implicit default)
#   - backend_version is pinned explicitly so the golden never drifts with DB updates
#   - gpus_per_node / is_moe / num_experts are not written in the YAML; they are
#     derived by resolve_model_hardware(model, hardware) and merged into engine.afd

traffic:
  source: {type: synthetic, input_tokens: 1024, output_tokens: 128}
  load:   {type: concurrency, concurrency: 8}
  stop:   {requests: 32}

engine:
  mode: afd
  model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B
  hardware: h200_sxm          # node width 8
  backend: sglang
  backend_version: "0.5.14"
  context_length: max
  afd:
    phase: both               # pure AFD must be both
    combined_with_pd: false   # no companion
    n_a_nodes: 1              # A pool (attention) node count
    n_f_nodes: 1              # F pool (FFN/MoE) node count
    tp_a: 1                   # TP of the A worker; must divide gpus_per_node
    a_batch_size: 18         # per-A-worker batch
    num_microbatches: 3
    # Optional defaults:
    # f_moe_ep_size: 8        # omitted EP resolves to the F GPU count
    # comm_overhead_factor: 1.0
    # boundary_on_attn: true

evaluation:
  sla: {ttft_ms: 800, itl_ms: 30}
cost_assessment: support/model gates run at preparation; Engine retains 16 bytes of compiled parallel identity; no new token/layer loop work
numerical_results: all non-wall-clock summary fields exactly equal in every matched pair
